children: MSP Recovery obtained four small, one-time financings totaling $0.12 million to support operating expenses. The company received two discretionary $0.03 million advances from Hazel Partners Holdings under its working capital facility’s Operational Collection Floor, which provides no ongoing commitment or borrowing base. MSP Recovery also executed the Third and Fourth Addenda with VRM MSP Recovery Partners for two separate $0.03 million advances of recovery proceeds, each limited to operational uses and without obligation for future funding.
